decisions_made: In response to the request for more impressive behavior, recommend exact-visible-area capture and visible-first cache reads, anchor-plus-offset passage continuity, optional hover/keyboard-selection preparation, and prepared-open p95 <=500 ms under 50 panes. All remain proposed, unmeasured additions.

Source confirms 2048-row capture bands and all-PNG cache reads before adoption; at the tested tall-page geometry 4096 captured rows cover 2240 visible rows. Exact capture offers 45.3125% fewer returned pixels, not an established elapsed-time gain.
PageDoc::land preserves fractional scroll, while adopt already carries notes and retains outgoing visible images. Anchor-relative continuity extends existing behavior.
